blocks.text: Is chapter ne data ko jama karne se faislon tak follow kiya: data ki qismein, machines us se kaise seekhti hain, model kaise banayein aur parkhein, andaze aur sabab ka farq, aur istemal hone wale tools. Table is ki bunyadi istilahat ikatthi karti hai.

blocks.caption: Chapter 6 ki kaleedi istilahat
rows: Data science
Mufeed maloomat aur faislon ke liye data jama, munazzam, tajzia aur tashreeh karna
Structured / unstructured data
Tables jaisi muqarrar shakal wala data / is ke baghair data, jaise tasaveer, videos, emails aur audio files
Machine learning
Artificial intelligence ki shaakh jis mein computers andaze ya faisle ke liye data se naqsh seekhte
Supervised / unsupervised / reinforcement learning
Labelled data se seekhna / labels ke baghair chhupe groups dhoondna / inaam aur saza se seekhna
Feature aur target value
Model ka input, jaise parhai ke ghante / jis output ka andaza ho, jaise imtihani score
Train-test split
Data ko training aur testing data mein baantna
Predictive model
Model jo pichhle data se aane wali qeematon ya nataij ka andaza lagaye
Model evaluation
Accuracy, error, precision, recall aur F1-score se karkardagi jaanchna
Parameter tuning
Karkardagi behtar karne ke liye model ki settings badalna
Prediction / causality
Pichhle data se aane wali qeemat ka andaza / sabab aur asar ke rishte batana
Machine learning tools
Data tajzia aur models banane ka software, jaise Excel, R, Python aur Jupyter Notebook

items: Machine learning: supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement; banana, baantna, jaanchna, tune karna.
Andaza sabab nahi; tools: Excel, R, Python.
